name: Iguazu National Park
description: In Argentina's far northeast, Iguazu National Park protects a huge curved wall of waterfalls on the Brazilian border. Dozens of separate cascades drop about 80 metres across a span of 2,700 metres, throwing up enormous clouds of spray. Around them, subtropical rainforest shelters over 2,000 plant species, plus tapirs, howler monkeys, jaguars and caymans.
